linkedin.about: I run a neighbourhood bakery and lead a team of five. I get up before dawn, I am always on the move, and I am a goofy storyteller who loves hosting dinner parties. Food, hospitality and generosity are what I care about most. Looking for someone who enjoys a big table and a loud brunch.
